title: Neel Ltd.: finding net profit before tax from balance sheets
body:
Neel Ltd. has not supplied its Statement of Profit and Loss for 2025-26. Its accountant gives the following from the comparative Balance Sheets and other records:
- Surplus, i.e. Balance in Statement of Profit and Loss: Rs. 3,00,000 on 31 March 2025 and Rs. 4,60,000 on 31 March 2026.
- Provision for Taxation: Rs. 40,000 on 31 March 2025 and Rs. 60,000 on 31 March 2026. Income tax of Rs. 35,000 was paid during 2025-26.
- The proposed dividend of Rs. 45,000 for 2024-25 was declared by the shareholders at the AGM held in 2025-26, debited to the surplus and paid within 30 days.
- There were no extraordinary items and no transfers to reserves during the year.
